name: Nintendo 64 Quest
overview: A decade after "Nintendo Quest," super collector Jay Bartlett is back with an epic new challenge: to find every Nintendo 64 game ever released in North America—all 296 cartridges—with a budget of $20,000 CAD and just 14 days to complete the task! Driven by a heartfelt mission, Jay plans to auction the collection, donating all proceeds to the Alzheimer’s Society in honor of his late mother.
